falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,620 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match, as that pattern formed after a 8.5% drawdown with no immediate recovery to highs; this would signal continuation rather than bottoming behavior

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would contradict the elevated uncertainty regime typical of bottom formations; the blowoff score of 43 suggests residual stress that should keep VIX elevated if the pattern holds

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens by more than 25 basis points (from current levels) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Aggressive curve steepening signals either inflation panic or growth acceleration, both inconsistent with the disinflationary/recovery bottom pattern of August 2024; the original bottom featured curve flattening on flight-to-safety flows
